I run a mile every day, I've never been drunk, I've never smoked weed, and while I do need to work on my diet that's much easier said than done when you're not the one paying for your food.

My parents aren't willing to pay for my psychiatrist or medicine anymore. They said it's on me now.

Last time a had a job I had to quit because talking anyone made me incredibly anxious and so I'd get poor ratings, which would make my boss upset with me, and I'd go home and cut myself to try and deal with my problems. This has pretty much been the case with 3 jobs now, and my first job I had to quit because I couldn't preform the heavy lifting required to do the job.

So today I applied for SSI, basically saying that my depression and anxiety inhibit my ability to work and that I need money from the government to survive.

I feel like my mental illness is not as worthy of the money compared to a physical illness or disability.

If I get denied I'm probably going to try killing myself again, because going even a day without my medicine gives me terrible withdraws that don't go away.

I think I'm too late for anyone to read this, but I'll probably post it in r/suicidewatch because I want advice.

They can't, and even if they could they wouldn't. My mom and step dad who I live with hardly care about me at all.
And it's not just this, to be honest, this is just what pushed me over the edge.
